description: Agent Readiness: submit one tool or service listing and its purchase flow in order (each step with its words, the credentials, accounts or approvals it asks for, and the step where payment happens). The signed report says whether an agent learns every credential requirement before the payment step, names each API key, token, account, authorization, identity check, approval or plan first disclosed at or after payment, and gives the disclosure point the listing should move each one to. Listing decidability is wever_catalog-listing-check. Verdict disclosed_late, requirements_unnamed, disclosed_before_payment or no_requirements_found. POST /api/credential-requirements-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-readiness-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-readiness/.
